items.headline: Nasdaq has its worst day since June as Meta's spending plans spook AI investors
items.why: Meta beat on revenue ($64.6B, +26.1%) but spent $34.9B on capex with negative free cash flow, and the stock fell about 7%; the market is now punishing AI spending that has not yet paid back, which spread to chip names.

items.headline: Tesla quietly lowers 2026 capex guidance to above $20B from above $25B
items.why: The cut sits in the 10-Q rather than the shareholder letter, and with $13B already spent it implies a sharp slowdown in Q4 spending, which reads as less AI and robotics build-out demand for suppliers.
